TABLE.NAME: block_oksigeniaaravo_snap
TABLE.COMMENT: The last snapshot read from the central registry, so the block works when the central does not answer. One row per site.

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: The snapshot JSON as the central sent it, or null if never read with success.

FIELD.NAME: generatedat
FIELD.COMMENT: When the central generated the snapshot (its generated_at), as a Unix time.

FIELD.NAME: fetchedat
FIELD.COMMENT: When Aravo last read with success, as a Unix time.

FIELD.NAME: attemptedat
FIELD.COMMENT: When Aravo last tried to read, with success or not, as a Unix time.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Result of the last read: ok, or a short error code.

FIELD.NAME: httpstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: HTTP status of the last read, or 0 if it did not get one.
